the relationship between the psychiatric, somatic and other functional disorders and IBS.

patients with IBS have a high prevalence of psychiatric, somatic and other FGIDs and reduced QOL and that these are not adequately addressed by current medical management of IBS.

patients presenting to our tertiary care center had a high prevalence of IBS with associated psychiatric, somatoform and other FGIDs and reduced QOL and very few of them were receiving psychiatric drug treatment.
